objective: Prevent live production teacher-auth provider readiness from issuing reusable ready evidence unless it is bound to a non-secret release-run id.
summary: The teacher-auth provider readiness harness now blocks live production runs when --release-run-id is missing.

This closes a gap where otherwise-valid trusted-cookie issuer evidence could be marked ready without being tied to the same release attempt as Vercel env apply, deployment, route smoke, browser smoke, storage smoke, and manual PPT acceptance.
The guard does not provision a production teacher auth provider; it hardens the evidence chain required before production proof can be accepted.

redGreenEvidence.result: failed before implementation because live production teacher-auth readiness exited 0 without --release-run-id.
passed after adding the release-run id guard.

checksNotRun: No live production teacher-auth provider was invoked with real credentials.
No Vercel env apply, production deploy, deployed route smoke, deployed browser smoke, external-storage production smoke, or manual PowerPoint/WPS playback acceptance was run.
blockers: Trusted teacher auth/session provider still needs owner-approved production env and live provider readiness evidence.
The Vercel project/team/link/env/deploy chain remains unproved.
External durable storage and manual PPT playback acceptance remain incomplete.
The overall enterprise UAIS E2E goal remains incomplete.
